description: This source file defines the 'Details' feature for user profiles in an ASP.NET Core application. It includes the Query class for requesting profile data, a validator for the query, and a handler that processes profile read requests via dependency injection.

classes.name: Details.Query
classes.description: Represents a request for retrieving profile details given a username.

classes.name: Details.QueryValidator
classes.description: Validates that the username in the query is not empty.

classes.name: Details.QueryHandler
classes.description: Handles the profile details request by reading the profile using injected profile reader service.

methods.name: Handle
methods.description: Processes the profile request by invoking profileReader.ReadProfile.
